Fact-check one claim from a short video using ONLY the numbered evidence.

VIDEO DATE: 2018-05-26
TRANSCRIPT EXCERPT: There has been a reduction in the MRP (Material requirements planning) of DAP, MOP, and complex fertilizers
CLAIM: There has been a reduction in the MRP (Material requirements planning) of DAP, MOP, and complex fertilizers
VERIFICATION QUESTIONS:
- Did the prices od DAP and MOP reduce in the years prior to this claim?
- Was this reduction to the government or it's policies?

EVIDENCE:
[1] https://africacheck.org/sites/default/files/Demyttenaere2004JAMA.pdf The proportion of respondents who received health care treatment for emotional or substance-use problems during the 12 months before the WMH
interview varies widely across surveys
(TABLE 5), from a low of 0.8% in Nigeria to a high of 15.3% in the United
States.
[2] https://web.archive.org/web/20201218103952/http://164.100.47.194/Loksabha/Questions/QResult15.aspx?qref=37164&lsno=16 It is true that the prices of DAP, MOP and other complex fertilizers reduced in the year 2016 as prices had come down in the international market and this reduction was purely because of market dynamics.
[3] https://web.archive.org/web/20201218103952/http://164.100.158.235/question/annex/247/Au1333.docx No
[4] https://www.cdc.gov/coronavirus/2019-ncov/prevent-getting-sick/cloth-face-cover-guidance.html Wearing a cloth face covering correctly can help prevent the spread of COVID19 to others.

VIDEO DATE: 2020-10-17
TRANSCRIPT EXCERPT: India's Congress party candidate Maskoor Usmani installed Jinnah's portrait at AMU.
CLAIM: India's Congress party candidate Maskoor Usmani installed Jinnah's portrait at AMU.
VERIFICATION QUESTIONS:
- What is Aaj Tak?
- Who was Jinnah?
- What is AMU?
- How long has the portrait of Jinnah been hanging at AMU?
- When was Maskoor Usmani a Congress candidate?

EVIDENCE:
[1] https://www.telegraphindia.com/india/advani-salutes-secular-jinnah/cid/873488 Standing before Jinnah’s tomb, Advani described the founder of Pakistan as “secular” and an “ambassador of Hindu-Muslim unity”.

That Jinnah believed in keeping statecraft and religion apart is a well-established fact of history...
[2] https://www.dailyo.in/politics/jinnah-portrait-aligarh-muslim-university-controversy-bjp-sangh-parivar-india-pakistan-amu-students-union-23850 Like portraits of most leaders inside the union building, Jinnah also found a spot. That portrait has been hanging at the AMU students' union hall for decades, and yet, it did not turn AMU into another Pakistan. The university remains a premier central institution, funded by the government itself.
[3] https://twitter.com/thewire_in/status/991882541337600000?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw A tweet on May 3, 2018 said:
For Jinnah portrait hanging since 1938....
[4] https://in.linkedin.com/company/aaj-tak Aaj Tak is an Entertainment company located in E-1, Videocon Tower jhandewalan Extn, New Delhi, Delhi, India.
[5] https://web.archive.org/web/20200803150511/https://indianexpress.com/article/entertainment/music/lata-mangeshkar-on-her-retirement-5480720/ No
[6] https://www.newindianexpress.com/nation/2020/oct/16/ln-mishras-grandson-denied-congress-ticket-calls-party-candidate-masqoor-usmani-anti-national-ji-2211130.html Congress has given Jale constituency ticket to former President of Aligarh Muslim University Student's Union Dr Maskoor Ahmad Usmani (published 16 October, 2020)
[7] https://www.amu.ac.in/about-us/facts Aligarh Muslim University (AMU) occupies a unique position amongst universities and institutions of higher learning in the country. It was established in 1920 and evolved out of the Mohammedan Anglo-Oriental (MAO ) which was set up on 7 January 1877 by the great visionary and social reformer, Sir Syed Ahmad khan. From its very inception, it has kept its door open to the members of all communities and from all corners of the country and the world. The Aligarh Muslim University s the realization of a vision which was broad, far-reaching and realistic
[8] https://www.nationalgeographic.com/culture/article/napkin-math-will-the-leaning-tower-of-pisa-ever-fall ...leans at 3.99 degrees.

Fact-check one claim from a short video using ONLY the numbered evidence.

VIDEO DATE: 2020-10-08
TRANSCRIPT EXCERPT: The CDC has said over 98,000 people had non-COVID related deaths because of hospitals that were closed down for non-essential services
CLAIM: The CDC has said over 98,000 people had non-COVID related deaths because of hospitals that were closed down for non-essential services
VERIFICATION QUESTIONS:
- Have 98,000 people had non-COVID related deaths because of hospitals that were closed down for non-essential services?
- Have the CDC reported on this?
- What does the CDC mean by excess deaths?
NUMBER CHECK (deterministic):
- claim says 98,000; nearest evidence figure 100,000 in [6] (close (within 10%))

EVIDENCE:
[1] https://web.archive.org/web/20210415193015/https://www.dol.gov/ui/data.pdf 12,445,532.
[2] https://web.archive.org/web/20210213211031/https://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=3015382625194292&set=a.140236026042314&type=3&theater As part of a stimulus package aimed at relieving the economy during the coronavirus pandemic, the Trump administration wants to send cash to Americans. That means you could get a check for $1,000 or more in the coming weeks, an idea that has drawn bipartisan support since Sen. Mitt Romney, R-Utah, called for every American adult to get a check for that amount "immediately."

But as Congress hammers out the details, there’s no discussion of weekly $700 checks, as a recent Facebook post claims.
[3] https://web.archive.org/web/20201224210321/https://www.whitehouse.gov/wp-content/uploads/2019/09/Unclassified09.2019.pdf A document of the call makes no mention of trump saying Zelensky should not call back until he’d satisfied Trump’s demands,
the call ended with Trump congratulating Zelensky on his election.
[4] https://web.archive.org/web/20210721131201/https://richmondvaannouncements.blogspot.com/search?updated-max=2019-03-22T11:28:00-04:00&max-results=7 Virginia.
[5] https://web.archive.org/web/20210302101747/https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jama/fullarticle/2768086 A July report in the Journal of the American Medical Association found 87,000 excess deaths nationwide from March 1 to April 25, with 45 percent of those, or more than 30,000, not attributed to COVID-19.
[6] https://www.cdc.gov/mmwr/Novel_Coronavirus_Reports.html A CDC report posted Tuesday said an estimated 299,028 excess deaths (above the expected baseline) occurred from late January through Oct. 3 in the United States.

About 198,000, or two-thirds, were attributed to COVID-19, the CDC said. This leaves about 100,000 excess deaths during that seven-month period that weren’t believed to be because of COVID-19.

VIDEO DATE: 2020-10-19
TRANSCRIPT EXCERPT: India's imports from China increased by 27% during the period April-August 2020.
CLAIM: India's imports from China increased by 27% during the period April-August 2020.
VERIFICATION QUESTIONS:
- How much was the India imports from China before April 2020?
- How was the Indian imports from China affected in the first 8 months of 2020?
- According to www.businesstoday.in on September 22, 2020
what did Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal say about India's imports from China?
NUMBER CHECK (deterministic):
- claim says 27%; nearest evidence figure 27.63% in [1] (close (within 10%))

EVIDENCE:
[1] https://www.businesstoday.in/current/economy-politics/imports-from-china-decline-by-27-63-during-april-august-2020-piyush-goyal/story/416674.html Imports from China decline by 27.63% during April-August 2020: Piyush Goyal

"India's imports from China have declined by 27.63 per cent during April-August, 2020-21 over the corresponding period of the previous year,"
[2] https://www.ringodaigaku.com/ringo_blog/english/2018/07/31/172.html Since it is of natural origin, it is safe to eat the wax. The linoleic acid and the oleic acid are types of *unsaturated fatty acids and said to have a rich nutritional value.
(*Unsaturated fatty acid helps decrease bad cholesterol.)
[3] https://www.cppr.in/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/CPPR-CSS-working-paper-003-2020.pdf Despite
working out several feasible options to protect the
trade industry, the India-China trade faced a decline
of 12.4 per cent in the initial two months of COVID-19.
The Economic Times and Global Times reported that
from January to February, India’s imports from China
were as less as US$ 9.5 billion and India’s exports to
China had dropped by US$ 2.5 billion (inferred from
the Chinese Customs Data). Though the imports and the exports have dropped, the trade deficit is still
significant.
[4] https://www.history.com/topics/india/indira-gandhi Indira Gandhi (1917-1984) served as India's first female prime minister from 1966 to 1977 and again from 1980 until her assassination
[5] https://www.drishtiias.com/daily-updates/daily-news-analysis/rising-imports-from-china For the seven months of 2020, India’s imports from China have reached USD 32.2 billion. However, It is still down by 24.7% year-on-year, mainly because of the record slump in April and May.

Through the pledge to Leave No One Behind, countries have committed to fast-track progress for those furthest behind first. That is why the SDGs are designed to bring the world to several life-changing ‘zeros’, including zero poverty, hunger, AIDS and discrimination against women and girls.
